run_qps_worker_server: run a gRPC QPS worker server on a specified port for performance testing
run_worker_server_cli: run the qps worker CLI module with --driver_port to start the gRPC performance testing server
review_run_worker_server: review the run_worker_server function that creates a test server and registers the WorkerServer servicer
test_qps_worker: test the gRPC QPS worker server by starting it on a port and sending performance requests
refactor_run_worker_server: refactor the run_worker_server function to support secure port binding instead of insecure
